WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        budget.link_to_event as event_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(budget.amount) IS NULL OR SUM(budget.amount) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(budget.spent) / SUM(budget.amount)
        END as spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY budget.link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
    SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as overall_avg
    FROM event_ratios
    WHERE spend_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    event_id,
    spend_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN spend_ratio IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE spend_ratio / (SELECT overall_avg FROM avg_ratio)
    END as relative_ratio
FROM event_ratios
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: When an event's total budgeted amount (sum of all budget.amount values) is zero or NULL, its spend_ratio is treated as NULL (undefined) rather than as a valid numeric value, because division by zero is undefined.
